thread:
ash: deploy-bot flagged a p95 regression on the embeddings release. It suggested auto-revert. I want to hold for 15m to try a quick hotpatch. Thoughts? :thinking:

deploy-bot: ALERT: p95_latency > 2s (1.8x baseline). Auto-revert scheduled in 5m unless suppressed. [ruleset: canary-slo-3]

maria: do we have a quick kernel patch? I can try patch + restart on canary pool.

sam: what is the failure mode? queueing on dedicated pools or a model change?

ash: looks like KV cache miss spike after the new kvcache LRU tweak. Error rates are fine, just latency.

lee: suggest suppressing auto-revert for 10m so maria can rollout hotpatch to 10% of canary. we need manual ack from eng-sre or release lead.

ops-bot: suppression requires 'release-lead' approval. Command: `/suppress-autorevert 1713456789 --duration 10m --reason 'hotpatch attempt'`

ash: i'm release-lead, acking. running suppression now.

ash: `/suppress-autorevert 1713456789 --duration 10m --reason 'hotpatch attempt'`

deploy-bot: suppression accepted by release-lead ash. Auto-revert postponed until +10m. Telemetry: p95 still 1.9s

maria: starting hotpatch rollout to canary slice `canary-1`. patch: adjust lru_threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75. ETA ~4m.

sam: please post the exact rollback command if patch fails.

maria: rollback (if needed): `./release-tools/revert --release 2026.03.21-emb-lru --target canary-1`

lee: ops, support, product-ela — I will draft a one-sentence customer note in case we need revert.

product-ela: thanks. prefer 'minor performance regression under investigation; we may briefly revert a canary change.' keep it short.

ash: maria report?

maria: patch applied to canary-1, initial p95 to 1.05s. no errors.

deploy-bot: telemetry: canary-1 p95=1.04s, overall p95=1.2s. suppression remains for 6m.

lee: looks good. recommend extend suppression 10m to monitor. ash to approve.

ash: approve extend 10m. `/suppress-autorevert extend 10m`

deploy-bot: suppression extended; auto-revert at +20m from original.

ops-bot: logging comms: release-notes draft pushed to docs/release/embeddings-hotpatch.md — product-ela please review.

product-ela: reviewed and approved. short note sent to #customer-status: 'Investigating a performance regression; partial fix applied to canary; no customer impact.'

sam: If regression reappears on other canaries, let's escalate to manual rollback. I have hands on standby.

ash: 👍 keep monitoring. if p95 > 2s across any 2 regions for 10m, rollback automatically allowed.

lee: copying summary to eng-sre channel for postmortem if we roll.

ash: closing thread unless we see a spike. :white_check_mark:
